name: Dissonant Melody
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting, pain]; Level bard 1, mesmerist 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous, see text
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You intone a discordant melody that only one creature within range can hear. The tone fills the target’s mind with pain and drives them away from you. The target takes 1d4 damage/level (maximum 5d4), deafened, and on their turn must move up to their movement speed away, or as far as they can safely move. A successful Will save halves the damage and negates the requirement to move on their turn and the deafening. Creatures immune to mind-affecting spells are immune to the damage inflicted by this spell.
